&api-questions;
The NetBeansFX Product API defines immutable product identity, icons, style, About, desktop-association and default-policy metadata, plus exactly-one provider discovery.
The module is model-tier and toolkit-free. Product contains no live shell, layout, theme or content object. Policy references are stable strings. Resource references are metadata only; this module performs no resource I/O.
Immutable product metadata and exactly-one provider discovery. This API remains devel until the CJAP reference product and scenarios pass.
Drive runtime title/icon/About, packaging and desktop metadata from one immutable product source.
Select the product default theme/layout/shell/chrome policy without implementation dependencies.
Reject missing or duplicate product providers before shell composition.
Unit tests cover immutable defensive copies, null/blank and URI validation, association rules, one-provider resolution, missing/duplicate provider failures and null provider results.
A JDK is required to compile and run the module.
Only org.netbeans.api.nbfx.product is public.
ProductProvider.resolve(Lookup) uses lookupAll and requires exactly one provider. It does not cache, sort for selection, deduplicate or apply priorities.
Product-owned NBM modules register their public no-argument provider implementation with @ServiceProvider(service = ProductProvider.class). Priority and superseding are not supported because they could conceal duplicate distribution providers.
None. Product selection is service-based, not layer-shadowing based.
None. ResourceRef values are resolved by the rendering or packaging boundary.
None.
Product values are immutable and the resolver is stateless. There is no thread affinity.
No code runs until a composition root explicitly calls ProductProvider.resolve.
No code runs on exit.
A distribution must provide exactly one ProductProvider before shell startup.
